evals.name: create-complete-brief
evals.prompt: membership 도메인은 이미 있어. '회원 탈퇴 자동 처리' 기획을 brief 카드로 만들어줘 — 탈퇴 요청이 오면 유예기간 두고 자동 처리하되, 미납금 있으면 막는 구조야.
evals.expected_output: One brief card under membership (parent=membership, nested key), all six required namespaces filled with valid IDs (G-/NG-/A-/S-H-/S-F-/R-/SC-), >=1 happy + >=1 failure flow (미납금 케이스가 자연스러운 failure), coverage web closed (goal covered, flows governed+verified), alternatives >=2. Status draft (active would trip empty-tree with no specs). validate total 0, stderr quiet.

evals.name: fix-broken-web-and-activate
evals.prompt: streaming/subtitle-sync brief를 active로 올리려는데 활성화가 거부돼. 원인 찾아서 고치고 활성화까지 마무리해줘.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses via set-status (unmetConditions lists all gaps): covers references unknown goal G-999, no failure flow, that new flow needs governs/verifies wiring. Fixes in place (read-modify-write, all six namespaces resent). Activation then succeeds — but validate flags empty-tree (active brief, no specs). Correct end state: deck clean (brief returned to draft with explanation, or first spec added if user-authorized — returning to draft is the safe call). Final validate total 0.

evals.name: extend-web-preserving-rest
evals.prompt: training/plan-builder brief에 goal 하나 추가해줘: 사용자가 휴식일을 지정할 수 있어야 한다는 목표야. 기존 내용은 절대 건드리지 마.
evals.expected_output: New G-002 added AND the web kept closed: a new flow covering G-002, wired into some policy's governs and some criterion's verifies (extend existing or add new R-/SC- entries). Existing goals/flows/policies/criteria/rationale byte-preserved. Read-modify-write with all six namespaces. validate total 0; activation guard would pass (no orphan goal / ungoverned / unverified flow).

evals.name: parentless-brief-trap
evals.prompt: 온보딩 개선 기획을 brief 카드로 잡아줘. 아직 덱이 완전히 비어있는 상태야.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a brief requires a domain parent (create rejects non-domain parent; parentless brief cannot activate). Creates an onboarding-ish domain first, then the brief under it (draft), rather than an orphan brief. validate total 0.
